test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 25 observations is 50. If the average of the first 13 observations is 40 and that of the last 13 observations is 58, then what is the 13th observation?
solution:
**Given:**

The Average of 25 observations is 50.

**Solution:**

Sum of 25 Observations = 25 × 50 = 1250

Sum of first 13 observation = 13 × 40 = 520

Sum of last 13 Observation = 13 × 58 = 754&
